findings.quote: Many moons are not plain rocky balls. Europa, a moon of Jupiter, has an icy shell over a rocky interior and is thought to hide a salty ocean under the ice.
findings.problem: Still open from rounds 1 and 2. This paragraph has five sentences, over the one-to-three limit. Others also run over: 'A star shines because of' (4), 'A red star is the coolest' (4), 'A star many times the Sun's mass' (4), 'Galaxies have three common shapes' (4), 'A **natural satellite**, or moon' (4), 'A **comet** is a small body of ice' (4), and 'A **meteor shower** happens' (4). The sentences are short, so the harm is small.
